children: Pinterest named James Dibbo as its chief financial officer.
Dibbo will start on Oct. 26 and succeeds Julia Donnelly, who submitted her resignation in August. Donnelly will stay on in an advisory capacity through the end of October.

Dibbo joins from Amazon, where he most recently served as finance chief for the e-commerce company's global entertainment, advertising and corporate development division. In that role, he led finance for businesses including Amazon Ads, Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, Audible and Twitch.
He spent a decade at Amazon, where he also served as chief financial officer of the company's global and North American consumer businesses.
Before joining Amazon, Dibbo was chief financial officer of P.F. Chang's. He previously held senior finance positions at Tesco and BT Group.
Pinterest plans to pay Dibbo an annual salary of $650,000 with eligibility for cash incentive bonuses.
